review.opening: A clean kill with one habit to fix: Bloodthirst sat ready while you had the rage for it.

fixFirst.title: Bloodthirst: 9 casts lost
fixFirst.why: Bloodthirst is the button the Fury rotation is built around, and 9 of a possible 40 went unused while you had the rage, longest at 1:12–1:25. At 2:40–2:51 you sat on a full bar instead, so that one gap cost you twice.
fixFirst.drillText: On a target dummy, press Bloodthirst the moment it comes off cooldown, before anything else; Whirlwind and Heroic Strike wait their turn.

thenFix.title: No flask at the pull
thenFix.why: A flask is the cheapest damage you will ever buy; bring one to every 40-player boss.

thenFix.title: Rage full for 14 seconds
thenFix.why: When the bar is full, Heroic Strike turns rage into damage instead of losing it.

doingWell.text: You were alive the whole fight.
Battle Shout was up 100% of the fight, against 97% for the top 25.

couldntCheck: Talents and race: Forever logs don't record them.
Range and movement: the log doesn't say where you stood.
